functions.description: Submit 3DS method or challenge completion data for an existing payment and continue processing.

securityCode.description: Real card verification code if merchant processing requires it; never returned.

challengeResponse.description: Exact ACS CRes received from the challenge; opaque protocol message, not caller-generated JSON.

legacyMerchantData.description: Opaque merchant correlation data returned in the legacy flow.

methodNotificationStatus.description: Observed 3DS method completion status; do not infer success.

completeDecoupledAuthentication.description: True requests the documented decoupled-completion step; false sends no additional step.

legacyPayerAuthenticationResponse.description: Exact legacy 3DS 1 issuer response; selects the deprecated legacy continuation only.

FunctionInput_fiserv_api_key_updatepayme.description: Actual authentication flow artifacts and optional security details for one existing payment continuation.

state.description: Financial state, not a settlement guarantee.

result.description: Processing result, preserving pending and partial outcomes.

methodForm.description: Provider-issued method HTML for further browser interaction.

redirectUrl.description: Further customer redirection destination when needed.

challengeRequest.description: Exact additional CReq message, if supplied.

FunctionOutput_fiserv_api_key_updatepaym.description: Immediate gateway processing outcome and any further customer interaction supplied by Fiserv.

apiSecret.description: Fiserv signing secret from the same Developer Portal application as the connection API key.

tags.instructions: Use paymentId from `create-payment` or `create-payment-authentication`. Supply data obtained from the actual authentication flow; never invent a successful result. Use `create-payment-authentication` to start 3DS instead. This can advance financial processing and returns immediately even if further customer interaction is needed. Legacy 3DS 1 responses are supported only for existing legacy flows.

functions.name: update-payment-authorization
functions.description: Request an incremental or decremental secondary preauthorization against an existing payment without resupplying the card.

amount.description: Exact amount supplied to the authorization-adjustment request in major units; gateway amount semantics must be validated before deployment.

comments.description: Comment for the new secondary authorization.

direction.description: Requested incremental or decremental authorization change.

FunctionInput_fiserv_api_key_updatepayme.description: A referenced incremental or decremental secondary preauthorization request.

amount.description: Exact amount reported for this transaction, not an inferred aggregate reserved balance.

result.description: Adjustment operation result.

FunctionOutput_fiserv_api_key_updatepaym.description: The secondary authorization transaction reported by Fiserv, without a computed reserved balance.

apiSecret.description: Fiserv application API secret paired with the connection API key, used for request signing.

tags.instructions: Use the original authorization's paymentId from `create-payment` or `get-payment`. Choose increase or decrease explicitly and supply the amount using the gateway's documented adjustment meaning validated for your processor. Use `create-payment-capture` to complete an authorization, not this tool. This changes reserved funds; reconcile before replay.

functions.name: update-payment-details
functions.description: Supply payer and application information for an existing preauthorization transaction.

comments.description: Comment for this action; empty string explicitly supplies an empty action comment.

consumerData.description: Payer values keyed by requested consumer-data type; omitted leaves them unsupplied.

additionalProperties.description: Requested payer value, preserved as text.

integrationData.description: Requested application values keyed by gateway integration-data names, such as RETURN_URL or PAYER_IP.

merchantParameters.description: Non-sensitive merchant tracking values; never card details or sensitive cardholder information.

FunctionInput_fiserv_api_key_updatepayme.description: Payer and application details to supply for an existing preauthorization.

result.description: Update/processing result.

redirectUrl.description: Next customer interaction destination when required.

FunctionOutput_fiserv_api_key_updatepaym.description: Payment processing outcome and any next customer interaction.

apiSecret.description: Fiserv API Secret from the same application as the connection API key, used for message signing.

tags.instructions: Use this only for an existing preauthorization. Obtain paymentId and required data keys from the payment response or `get-payment`. Use `update-payment-authorization` to change the reserved amount through an incremental/decremental authorization, and `update-payment-authentication` for 3DS. Supplying data can advance processing; check state before repeating.

functions.name: update-payment-schedule
functions.description: Partially modify future recurring schedule settings while retaining settings not supplied by the caller.

amount.description: New exact recurring total in major units.

comments.description: New schedule comment; empty string requests clearing the comment.

invoiceNumber.description: Replacement invoice reference; no null or empty clearing.

maximumFailures.description: New failure threshold before retries cease.

numberOfPayments.description: New configured occurrence count according to gateway semantics.

referencedOrderId.description: Existing order supplying a replacement payment source.

changes.description: Settings to replace; omitted settings are intended to remain unchanged.

FunctionInput_fiserv_api_key_updatepayme.description: Schedule reference and the future recurring settings to replace.

state.description: Schedule lifecycle state after the request.

result.description: Schedule-update operation result.

paymentId.description: Related financial transaction ID if returned.

paymentResult.description: Related financial operation result when returned.

FunctionOutput_fiserv_api_key_updatepaym.description: Gateway schedule-update result and any explicitly returned financial operation details.

apiSecret.description: Fiserv application secret used to sign requests for the connection API key.

storeId.description: Default Fiserv outlet for this connection.

tags.instructions: Use orderId from `create-payment-schedule` or `get-payment-schedule`. This changes future recurring charges, not payments already processed. Omit settings to retain them; null clearing is not supported. Use `cancel-payment-schedule` to stop the schedule, not an empty update. Concurrent schedule changes are not guaranteed atomic.

functions.name: update-payment-token
functions.description: Update one stored token's card details or reuse setting using the gateway's native token-update request.

brand.description: Selected brand for a dual-brand card.

expiryYear.description: New two-digit expiry year; supply with expiryMonth.

expiryMonth.description: New two-digit expiry month; supply with expiryYear.

securityCode.description: Verification code if required for update; never returned.

cardholderName.description: Replacement cardholder name; empty string requests clearing if supported.

card.description: Card fields to update; omitted fields intended to remain unchanged.

reusable.description: New token reuse setting; omit to retain existing setting.

declineDuplicates.description: Duplicate-data policy for this update; omitted sends no policy override.

FunctionInput_fiserv_api_key_updatepayme.description: Intended changes to one existing stored payment token.

id.description: Token value targeted by the update.

errors.description: Provider update diagnostics; absent when none supplied.

message.description: Provider explanation, with sensitive card data redacted.

items.description: One native update diagnostic with sensitive card data redacted.

result.description: Native request status, not an invented updated record.

FunctionOutput_fiserv_api_key_updatepaym.description: Native acknowledgment of the requested token update, not read-back confirmation.

apiSecret.description: Fiserv application API secret paired with the connection API key, used for request signing.

tags.instructions: Use paymentTokenId from `create-payment-token` or `get-payment-token`. Supply only intended changes; omitted settings should be retained and null clearing is unsupported. Use `batch-update-payment-tokens` for up to 100 tokens. Updating a token changes future uses, not historical payment records; check the token after an ambiguous result.

functions.name: upload-dispute-document
functions.description: Upload one evidence file and attach it to a dispute case.

filename.description: Evidence filename with a supported extension.

documentNote.description: Optional internal attachment note; empty string is preserved.

contentBase64.description: Standard Base64 of exact evidence bytes; decoded file must be at most 5,000,000 bytes under the conservative 5 MB policy.

networkFormType.description: Card-scheme network form associated with the attachment.

FunctionInput_fiserv_api_key_uploaddispu.description: One dispute evidence file, its current case token, and attachment classification.

disputeId.description: Dispute to which the evidence was attached.

FunctionOutput_fiserv_api_key_uploaddisp.description: The attached evidence document identifier and its dispute.

apiSecret.description: Developer Portal application API secret used to generate Message-Signature.

institutionNumber.description: Institution number; required for API access spanning multiple institutions.

tags.instructions: Get the case tcn from `get-dispute` and obtain the institution's template category code. Upload one JPG, JPEG, TIF, TIFF, PDF, DOCX or DOC file, at most 5 MB. This adds evidence; it does not itself execute a dispute action. Use `download-dispute-document` for existing file bytes.
